hooks.command: if command -v tako-hook >/dev/null 2>&1; then tako-hook claude user_prompt_submit; else if [ -n "$TAKO_SOCKET" ] && [ "${#TAKO_SURFACE_ID}" -eq 36 ]; then takoctl status set working --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" --text "Thinking..." >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; takoctl progress indeterminate --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; :; fi; :

if command -v tako-hook >/dev/null 2>&1; then tako-hook claude permission_request; else if [ -n "$TAKO_SOCKET" ] && [ "${#TAKO_SURFACE_ID}" -eq 36 ]; then takoctl status set needs_approval --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" --text "Approval requested" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; takoctl progress pause --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; :; fi; :

if command -v tako-hook >/dev/null 2>&1; then tako-hook claude question; else if [ -n "$TAKO_SOCKET" ] && [ "${#TAKO_SURFACE_ID}" -eq 36 ]; then takoctl status set waiting_for_input --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" --text "Question" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; :; fi; :
if [ -n "$TAKO_SOCKET" ] && [ "${#TAKO_SURFACE_ID}" -eq 36 ]; then takoctl notify "$CLAUDE_NOTIFICATION" --title "Claude Code" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; :

if command -v tako-hook >/dev/null 2>&1; then tako-hook claude stop; else if [ -n "$TAKO_SOCKET" ] && [ "${#TAKO_SURFACE_ID}" -eq 36 ]; then takoctl status set done --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; takoctl progress clear --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; :; fi; :

if command -v tako-hook >/dev/null 2>&1; then tako-hook claude session_end; else if [ -n "$TAKO_SOCKET" ] && [ "${#TAKO_SURFACE_ID}" -eq 36 ]; then takoctl status clear --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; takoctl progress clear --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; :; fi; :

if command -v tako-hook >/dev/null 2>&1; then tako-hook claude question_answered; else if [ -n "$TAKO_SOCKET" ] && [ "${#TAKO_SURFACE_ID}" -eq 36 ]; then takoctl status set working --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" --text "Thinking..." >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; takoctl progress indeterminate --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; :; fi; :
